With its five kilometers of fine sandy beach and shallow waters, it offers optimal conditions for riders. </p><div class="columns" style="align-items:center;"><div class="columns__item texte fade-right" style="align-self:center;"><h3>Customized training <span class="fc-span">with KGG and MF Kite</span></h3><p>The KGG and MF Kite schools offer courses for everyone, from beginners to advanced kiteboarders.</p><div class="lireplus fc-desk"><p>Read more</p><div class="group"><p>With qualified instructors, state-of-the-art equipment and small-group lessons, they guarantee quality supervision.</p><p>KGG stands out for its diversity, also offering wakeboarding and water-skiing courses. MF Kite, renowned for its sea sessions and personalized courses, completes the experience with the possibility of buying or renting equipment. Take advantage of an exceptional learning environment to master or perfect your kiteboarding skills.  </p></div></div><div class="buttons mini "><a href="https://kitesurfhyeres.com/" rel="noreferrer noopener" target="_blank" class="buttons__btn">Discover KGG</a><a href="https://www.mfkite.com/" rel="noreferrer noopener" target="_blank" class="buttons__btn">Discover MF Kite</a></div></div><div class="columns__item media fade-left" style="align-self:center;"><div class="gallery"><figure class="gallery__item ombre"><picture><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/surf-816x1024-1-420x420.webp" media="(max-width: 210px)"><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/surf-816x1024-1-677x850.webp" media="(max-width: 420px)"><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/surf-816x1024-1-768x964.webp" media="(max-width: 850px)"><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/surf-816x1024-1-816x1024.webp" media="(max-width: 1024px)"><source srcset="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/surf-816x1024-1.webp" media="(min-width: 1025px)"><img decoding="async" src="https://acampa-vacances.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/surf-816x1024-1-420x420.webp" width="420" height="210" loading="lazy" alt="surf 816x1024 1" title="Sport and wellness activities 15"></picture></figure></div></div></div></div>
